# Will this rental clear the lender's DSCR?

> Free rental property DSCR calculator for investors. Enter price, rent, loan terms and costs to see DSCR both ways, cash-on-cash, cap rate, break-even occupancy, the largest loan a target DSCR allows, and how a higher rate changes it. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
